description: Comprehensive catalog of NASA Planetary Data System (PDS), USGS Astrogeology, and robotic mission resources integrated into the MARS-X Human Marswalk Mission Planner.

pds_nodes.name: PDS Cartography and Imaging Sciences Node
pds_nodes.institution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA JPL

missions_and_instruments.dataset_name: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (MEGDR)
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Global baseline Martian datum, planet-scale 3D globe elevation rendering, and regional elevation offsets for all 6 exploration sites.
Micro-topography, meter-scale boulder field distribution, cliff scarp slope gradients, and landing site obstacle verification.

missions_and_instruments.instrument: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM)
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Multi-spectral mineral overlays: phyllosilicates (clays at 2.2 µm band depth), crystalline hematite (860 nm band), and polyhydrated sulfates (1.9/2.4 µm).
Panchromatic albedo basemaps, backdrop horizon texturing, and regional geomorphology context.

missions_and_instruments.dataset_name: THEMIS Daytime and Nighttime Infrared Global Mosaics
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Thermal inertia mapping to distinguish consolidated bedrock and competent outcrop from hazardous unconsolidated dust deposits.
Real-time diurnal atmospheric simulation (atmospheric pressure 7.2 hPa, ground temperatures -22°C to -48°C, and local wind speed vectors).

missions_and_instruments.dataset_name: RAD Calibrated Particle and Dose Data (EDR/RDR)
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Surface radiation environment model (0.64 - 0.70 mSv/day equivalent human dose) and topological radiation hazard mapping.

missions_and_instruments.dataset_name: NASA Mars 2020 Raw Image Repository & Telemetry Feed
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Direct in-app telemetry linkage to raw rover imaging for Jezero Crater science target verification and rover position tracking.

missions_and_instruments.dataset_name: Unified Geologic Map of Mars (USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292)
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Stratigraphic rock units, geologic fault lines, crater chronologies, and mineral resource classifications across all exploration zones.

missions_and_instruments.instrument: NASA Ames / Glenn / JPL 3D Model Repositories
missions_and_instruments.application_in_marsx: Official NASA 3D models for orbital communications relays (TDRS for RELAY-1/2), surface base camp (HDU Part 1 for HAB-1), and EVA astronaut traversal avatar (ACES for EV-1).
